title: [DEV 3.2.0-dev-j cd9f5e4] Problem opening preferences
body:
When opening any option that accesses anything related to preferences, the application crashes and closes. I haven't had any problems until today. I attach the logs and video.

The last error is around 20:59 (see video)

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/11655834/AndroidAPS.log)

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/67511778/5c188225-4f53-4f0b-8a06-1b630c0c64bc

Thanks.
